<b>Spool Extender</b> is a {{CrestSlot|Blue|1}} in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. It increases [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]]'s [[Silk|Silk capacity]] while equipped.

== Usefulness ==
Increases the capacity of [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]]'s [[Silk]] Spool by 3, even while she has an uncollected [[Cocoon]].
* Especially useful when having 6-8 extra Spools (gained from 12-17 [[Spool Fragment]]s), as it will help cross the threshold of letting Hornet [[Bind]] twice when at full Silk.
{{MissingImage}}

== How to Acquire ==
Purchased from [[Jubilana]] in [[Songclave]] for {{R|720}} after completing the <i>[[Wayfarer Wishes|WAYFARER]]:[[The Wandering Merchant]]</i> wish.
